subject: Supplier renewal and expansion choreography
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Maya Ortiz <procurement@brightline.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier renewal and expansion choreography

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. As discussed, Brightline's renewal for Q1 next year will include the 30% capacity uplift and a proposed term change (12 -> 24 months) tied to the volume discount schedule. To keep procurement moving, here's what we'd like to align on this week: 

- Confirmation of the procurement portal path Brightline will use (Ariba / Coupa / internal PO). If you can confirm the SRM/vendor ID we should use, we can pre-seed the onboarding.
- A single purchase approach vs split POs: we recommend one PO referencing SOW v2 + the renewal amendment; if you need separate POs (PO for committed capacity, PO for add-on), flag which departments will own each.
- Final pricing tier for the 30% uplift (we'll send the updated quote attached).

Attached: Renewal-SOW-v2.pdf (SOW with uplift section), SOC2-2025.pdf (attestation).

If it helps, I can share a pre-filled PO template and a short vendor onboarding checklist your SRM team can use. Happy to do a 15-min call tomorrow to run through the steps — what time works?

Best,
Dev Patel
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0194

Attachments: Renewal-SOW-v2.pdf (PDF), SOC2-2025.pdf (PDF)
From: Maya Ortiz <procurement@brightline.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Li <kevin.li@brightline.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier renewal and expansion choreography

Hi Dev —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few items from procurement's side: 

1) We use Ariba for vendor onboarding and Coupa for PO issuance depending on the business unit. For this renewal the payment will come from Clinical Ops (Coupa).
2) We will need a completed vendor form (W9/Tax ID, remittance address, banking stub) to complete the SRM refresh — I've attached our vendor-form.xlsx.
3) Regarding POs: Clinical Ops prefers a single consolidated PO referencing the SOW + amendment. If Finance requires split billing we will advise, but plan for consolidated for now.

Action items for Redwood: please provide the vendor tax info and a sample PO line item mapping to your pricing tiers so we can map to our COA.

I initiated a vendor registration in Ariba for Redwood (vendor record pending). Ariba will send an auto-confirm once the record is active — I'll forward that as soon as it arrives.

Thanks —
Maya Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Brightline Health
procurement@brightline.com

Attachment: vendor-form.xlsx (Excel)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Maya Ortiz <procurement@brightline.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 13:20:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier renewal and expansion choreography

On Thu, Oct 29, 2026 at 10:03 AM Maya Ortiz <procurement@brightline.com> wrote:
> I initiated a vendor registration in Ariba for Redwood (vendor record pending).

Thanks, Maya — appreciate the Ariba kick-off. Attached below are the items you requested and a pre-filled PO template for Clinical Ops: 

- Redwood legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID (EIN): 27-3946123
- Remittance address: 1100 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94102
- AP email for invoices: billing@redwood.com
- Bank info: (refer to attached banking-stub.pdf). If you need a W9 we can push that as well.

I've also attached a sample PO mapping that ties our SKU lines to your COA. Laura, looping you in to confirm the final pricing tier for the 30% uplift; we propose the Tier-2 rate in the attached quote which yields ~18% off list for the blended term.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm Ariba vendor ID once active and share the confirmation.
- Brightline issues a consolidated PO referencing SOW v2 + Renewal Amendment (Ref: DL-7342).
- Upon PO receipt we will execute the amendment and schedule a kickoff for the expansion cutover window.

I can be available 2–3pm PT tomorrow for a quick call if that fits your schedule.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: vendor-tax-stub.pdf (PDF), Sample-PO-ClinicalOps.xlsx (Excel)

Hi Maya / team —

Quick note from legal on the amendment: we are OK to move the term to 24 months provided Brightline agrees to the agreed-upon SLA floor and the capacity uplift clause language in section 4.2. Payment terms remain Net30. I've attached a redline for the Renewal Amendment (Renewal-Amendment-Redline.docx). Please review and advise if your legal / procurement needs any alternate language for vendor acceptance in Ariba.

Also: for Ariba onboarding, please let us know the exact vendor category and whether Brightline requires additional compliance artifacts (bank KYC, COBRA certificates, etc.).

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
